18.t: Working with data: testing a cold pack
q: Read the lowest temperature for 20 g.
More ammonium nitrate gives a lower temperature, but the effect levels off above about 40 g.
Suggest why adding more than 40 g makes little difference.
The water is close to saturated: extra solid cannot dissolve, so it takes in no more energy.
A pack must stay above 0 °C so it does not damage skin. Recommend a mass, with a reason.
About 30 g: cold enough (3 °C) to help an injury, but safely above 0 °C. 40 g reaches 0 °C, too risky.
